propositions.statement: A current Land Registry folio is evidence of the registered title position for the registered property, subject to the register, entries and applicable law.
A registry map or title-plan representation must not automatically be treated as conclusive proof of the precise physical boundary or every aspect of the property's extent.
A contractual transaction, succession entitlement or probate process must be distinguished from the subsequent registration of the relevant ownership position in the Land Register.
Registered ownership does not by itself establish planning permission, building-regulations compliance or lawful use/development of the property.
Property tax treatment must be determined by the relevant property event, parties, consideration or value, date and applicable tax regime rather than by property ownership alone.

version_rules: Every proposition has a version history.
Historical propositions remain available when relevant.
Amendment or supersession creates a new proposition version rather than silently overwriting the old one.
Every published proposition must have an evidence chain.
Every calculator, question, document validator and website explanation must reference canonical proposition IDs.
